measurement_notes: The unaligned query harness had a prefix64/min timing difference of about +18% for direct4 despite identical 44 generated query functions. Function addresses differed by 32 bytes.

Repeat measurements with all query entry points aligned to 64 bytes removed that difference. Original and aligned raw results are retained; aligned entry points are in the test harness only, not in the library.

Other small differences overlap control variation. Source/machine-code preservation establishes that unchanged operations acquire no new algorithmic work, not a wall-clock guarantee for all compiler layouts or machines.
